# Tides Info Label

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/tides-info-label`

Real consumers: **1** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The typographic Tides eyebrow: uppercase copy followed by a filled one-em information glyph, with one shared definition reveal across the complete label.

> **Guidance:** Use this label to introduce a tide-disc group. Hover, keyboard focus, and touch-hold reveal the canonical Tides InfoCard; InlineGlyph keeps the information mark centered on the surrounding capital height.

## Props

This component takes no props.

## Usage

Place the fixed label beside or above a group of semantic TideDisc objects.

```tsx
import { TidesInfoLabel } from "src/cumulus/components/hud/TidesInfoLabel";

<TidesInfoLabel />
```
